commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' 3 - 3 GOAL! Michael Gregoritsch connects with a delightful cross and heads it towards Sasa Kalajdzic (Austria), whose header goes past Oussama Benbot. 3:3.
90+5' Here is a change. Phillipp Mwene is going off and Ralf Rangnick gives the last tactical orders to Sasa Kalajdzic (Austria).
90+4' Houssem Aouar goes off the pitch and Fares Ghedjemis (Algeria) comes on.

90+3' 3 - 2 Goal! Houssem Aouar plays in Riyad Mahrez (Algeria), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box slots it into the bottom left corner 3:2.

45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Ilgiz Tantashev blows his whistle and it's Xaver Schlager (Austria) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
45+2' Nicolas Seiwald (Austria) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
45+2' Marcel Sabitzer (Austria) will take a corner kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

45' 1 - 1 Rafik Belghali (Algeria) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Alexander Schlager is just a bystander as the ball flies into the top right corner. The score is 1:1.

44' It's unbelievable, Ibrahim Maza (Algeria) blows a huge opportunity! He is totally unmarked and fires a first-time shot towards goal from a few yards out, but Alexander Schlager reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
42' Riyad Mahrez (Algeria) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
41' Phillipp Mwene (Austria) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the left post.
40' Fares Chaibi (Algeria) wastes a promising chance! He tries his luck with a shot from mid-range, but his effort hits the right post. A few inches to the left and it could have been a sweet goal!
37' David Alaba (Austria) takes a short corner kick.
36' A great run from Ibrahim Maza (Algeria) ends with a shot inside the box that flashes just past the left post.
33' Konrad Laimer (Austria) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Oussama Benbot.
32' Close! Rafik Belghali (Algeria) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
32' A pass from Konrad Laimer (Austria) is intercepted by Oussama Benbot and the move breaks down.
30' Flag goes up against Marko Arnautovic (Austria) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
28' 0 - 1 Goal! David Alaba sends a precise cross into the box, Marko Arnautovic (Austria) latches on to it and puts the ball into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:1.
27' Fares Chaibi (Algeria) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
23' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
22' Austria seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
19' Flag up against Konrad Laimer (Austria). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
16' Konrad Laimer (Austria) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
13' Ibrahim Maza (Algeria) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
11' Aissa Mandi (Algeria) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
11' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Marko Arnautovic (Austria) was quite harsh and Ilgiz Tantashev didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

10' What a poor attempt! Ibrahim Maza (Algeria) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes miles wide to the right.
9' Marcel Sabitzer (Austria) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
8' Nicolas Seiwald (Austria) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.
7' The game is interrupted. Marcel Sabitzer (Austria) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
4' Phillipp Mwene (Austria) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
3' Riyad Mahrez (Algeria) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Ilgiz Tantashev no option but to blow his whistle.
3' The Algeria players are exchanging some short passes and control the game at the moment, but one of the defending players steps in and intercepts the ball.
